mapper.sql: left join lateral ( select count(distinct c.id) as chunk_count, count(distinct c.id) filter (where exists(select 1 from cm_chunk_knowledge mapped where mapped.chunk_id = c.id)) as mapped_chunk_count, count(distinct c.id) filter (where not exists(select 1 from cm_chunk_knowledge mapped where mapped.chunk_id = c.id)) as unmapped_chunk_count, count(distinct ck.knowledge_point_id) as knowledge_point_count, count(distinct image.id) as image_count from cm_document_chunk c left join cm_chunk_knowledge ck on ck.chunk_id = c.id left join cm_document_image image on image.chunk_id = c.id where c.document_id = d.id ) stats on true left join lateral ( select ib.id, ib.source_file_name, ib.source_file_size, ib.source_file_hash, ib.status, ib.valid_count, ib.warning_count, ib.failed_count, ib.create_time, ib.finished_time from cm_import_batch ib where ib.document_id = d.id and ib.import_type = 'document_chunk' order by ib.create_time desc, ib.id desc limit 1 ) latest on true
mapper.select:
select cast(d.id as varchar) as id, cast(d.certification_id as varchar) as certification_id, cast(d.syllabus_version_id as varchar) as syllabus_version_id, case when sv.id is null then null else concat(ec.certification_name, ' · ', sv.version_name) end as syllabus_version_name, ec.certification_name, d.title, d.edition, d.status, coalesce(stats.chunk_count, 0) as chunk_count, coalesce(stats.mapped_chunk_count, 0) as mapped_chunk_count, coalesce(stats.unmapped_chunk_count, 0) as unmapped_chunk_count, coalesce(stats.knowledge_point_count, 0) as knowledge_point_count, cast(latest.id as varchar) as latest_import_batch_id, latest.status as latest_import_status, cast(d.create_by as varchar) as create_by, coalesce(creator.nick_name, creator.user_name) as create_by_name, d.create_time, d.update_time, false as deletable, null::varchar as delete_disabled_reason from cm_document d join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id = d.certification_id left join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id = d.syllabus_version_id left join sys_user creator on creator.user_id = d.create_by
order by
d.title d.create_time coalesce(stats.chunk_count, 0) d.update_time
ascdesc, d.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select cast(ec.id as varchar) as id, ec.certification_name as label from cm_exam_certification ec where ec.status = '0' order by ec.sort_order, ec.certification_name, ec.id

select distinct cast(d.create_by as varchar) as id, coalesce(u.nick_name, u.user_name, cast(d.create_by as varchar)) as label from cm_document d left join sys_user u on u.user_id = d.create_by where d.document_type = 'textbook' and d.del_flag = '0' and d.create_by is not null and d.create_by = #{visibleUserId} order by label

select d.id, d.syllabus_version_id, d.certification_id, case when sv.id is null then null else concat(ec.certification_name, ' · ', sv.version_name) end as syllabus_version_name, d.title, d.edition, d.status, d.create_by, coalesce(creator.nick_name, creator.user_name) as create_by_name, d.create_time, d.update_time, coalesce(submitter.nick_name, submitter.user_name) as submitted_by_name, d.submitted_time, coalesce(reviewer.nick_name, reviewer.user_name) as reviewed_by_name, d.reviewed_time, d.review_comment, coalesce(publisher.nick_name, publisher.user_name) as published_by_name, d.published_time, coalesce(stats.chunk_count, 0) as chunk_count, coalesce(stats.mapped_chunk_count, 0) as mapped_chunk_count, coalesce(stats.unmapped_chunk_count, 0) as unmapped_chunk_count, coalesce(stats.knowledge_point_count, 0) as knowledge_point_count, coalesce(stats.image_count, 0) as image_count, latest.id as latest_import_batch_id, latest.source_file_name, latest.source_file_size, latest.source_file_hash, latest.status as latest_import_status, latest.valid_count, latest.warning_count, latest.failed_count, latest.create_time as latest_import_create_time, latest.finished_time as latest_import_finished_time from cm_document d join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id = d.certification_id left join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id = d.syllabus_version_id left join sys_user creator on creator.user_id = d.create_by left join sys_user submitter on submitter.user_id = d.submitted_by left join sys_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id = d.reviewed_by left join sys_user publisher on publisher.user_id = d.published_by
where d.id = #{id} and d.document_type = 'textbook' and d.del_flag = '0' and d.create_by = #{visibleUserId}
select id from cm_document where id = #{id} and document_type = 'textbook' and del_flag = '0' and create_by = #{visibleUserId} for update
select id from cm_exam_certification where id = #{certificationId} and status = '0'
mapper.update: update cm_document set title = #{title}, certification_id = #{certificationId}, syllabus_version_id = case when #{clearSyllabusVersion} then null else syllabus_version_id end, update_by = #{userId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and document_type = 'textbook' and del_flag = '0'

update cm_document set status = 'published', published_by = #{userId}, published_time = now(), update_by = #{userId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and document_type = 'textbook' and del_flag = '0' and status = 'draft'

update cm_document set status = 'draft', published_by = null, published_time = null, update_by = #{userId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and document_type = 'textbook' and del_flag = '0' and status = 'published'
mapper.select: select syllabus_version_id, exam_subject_id from cm_knowledge_point where id = #{knowledgePointId} and del_flag = '0'

choose.when: and exists ( with recursive descendants as ( select id from cm_knowledge_point where id = #{knowledgePointId} and del_flag = '0' union all select child.id from cm_knowledge_point child join descendants parent on child.parent_id = parent.id where child.del_flag = '0' ) select 1 from cm_chunk_knowledge ck join descendants target on target.id = ck.knowledge_point_id where ck.chunk_id = c.id )
and exists (select 1 from cm_chunk_knowledge ck where ck.chunk_id = c.id and ck.knowledge_point_id = #{knowledgePointId})
choose.otherwise: and exists (select 1 from cm_chunk_knowledge ck join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id = ck.knowledge_point_id where ck.chunk_id = c.id and kp.exam_subject_id = #{examSubjectId} and kp.del_flag = '0')

choose.when: and exists (select 1 from cm_chunk_knowledge ck where ck.chunk_id = c.id)
choose.otherwise: and not exists (select 1 from cm_chunk_knowledge ck where ck.chunk_id = c.id)

sql.if: and (c.heading ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.content ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: c.id, c.document_id, c.chunk_order, c.heading, c.content, c.heading_path::text as heading_path, c.source_locator::text as source_locator, c.content_hash, coalesce(points.value, '[]'::jsonb)::text as knowledge_points, c.update_time, d.status as document_status

join cm_document d on d.id = c.document_id and d.document_type = 'textbook' and d.del_flag = '0' left join lateral ( select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'id', cast(kp.id as varchar), 'subjectNo', case es.subject_code when 'COMPREHENSIVE' then 1 when 'CASE_ANALYSIS' then 2 when 'ESSAY' then 3 else null end, 'code', kp.syllabus_number, 'title', kp.syllabus_title ) order by kp.id) as value from cm_chunk_knowledge ck join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id = ck.knowledge_point_id and kp.del_flag = '0' join cm_exam_subject es on es.id = kp.exam_subject_id where ck.chunk_id = c.id ) points on true
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_document_chunk c where c.document_id = #{documentId}
select from cm_document_chunk c where c.document_id = #{documentId} and c.id = #{chunkId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_chunk_knowledge(id, chunk_id, knowledge_point_id) values (#{row.id}, #{row.chunkId}, #{row.knowledgePointId})
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_document_chunk where document_id = #{documentId} and id in #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from cm_document_image where chunk_id in (select id from cm_document_chunk where document_id = #{documentId} and id in #{id})
delete from cm_chunk_knowledge where chunk_id in (select id from cm_document_chunk where document_id = #{documentId} and id in #{id})
delete from cm_document_chunk where document_id = #{documentId} and id in #{id}
mapper.update: update cm_document set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{userId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and document_type = 'textbook' and del_flag = '0'
